description: Invite a colleague to your company's RepuTend account by email (owner only). They get an email with a one-time code that their own AI assistant redeems for their own key; you never handle keys. A member can do everything except billing and team changes. A team has a size limit, you included (2 people today; list_team shows it): while fewer people than that have joined, one invite can be pending, and inviting someone new replaces it, so the earlier code stops working. You can send 2 invite emails a day, sending one again included. Inviting someone already on the team sends them a new code; redeemed without their key, it gives them a new one in place of the old (a lost key). Someone already on another RepuTend team joins with the key they have. (capability: team.manage_own)

company.description: The company to act for, by its Trustpilot domain (for example aioseo.com), one of those list_companies shows. Needed only when your key reaches more than one company.

name: invite_member
